feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 8 (wheel_track 0.10 m, y 0.08 m, kp 5.0) scored 60.32, with s-bend progress 0.1604 and oval 0.167, and slalom steering_oscillation 0.157, the binding constraint. Iterations 6 and 7 showed forward lead is on a plateau, so further drivetrain change is the remaining test. Iteration 3 showed kp alone does not move the s-bend, so I expect the gain from track width, not kp, to drive any progress change. I have built this candidate at wheel_track 0.09 m with kp 4.6 to hold the effective turn gain near iteration 8. Decide the next step from the race. If s-bend progress rises above 0.1604 and slalom steering_oscillation stays below 0.16, keep the layout and test wheel_track 0.08 m at mass 0.8 kg. If slalom oscillation rises to 0.16 or above with line loss unchanged, the Integrator should reduce kp further before any more geometry change, and the geometry fallback is wheel_track 0.10 m. If s-bend progress is flat near 0.16 or worse, revert to wheel_track 0.10 m and treat the drivetrain as exhausted at this sensing.
requested_changes: If s-bend progress rises above 0.1604 with slalom steering_oscillation below 0.16, keep y = 0.08 m and try wheel_track 0.08 m at mass 0.8 kg. Evidence: iteration 8 moved s-bend from 0.1496 to 0.1604 when wheel_track fell from 0.12 m to 0.10 m.

If slalom steering_oscillation rises to 0.16 or above with line_loss_events unchanged, keep wheel_track at 0.09 m and let the Integrator reduce kp before further geometry change. If geometry must change, use wheel_track 0.10 m. Evidence: iteration 8 slalom oscillation was 0.157 at wheel_track 0.10 m, and iteration 7 was 0.144 at 0.12 m.

If s-bend progress is flat near 0.16 or worse, revert to wheel_track 0.10 m and keep the 16 mm contiguous layout at x = ±0.048 m, y = 0.08 m. Evidence: iteration 4's 20 mm pitch cut slalom progress from 0.106 to 0.035 and did not improve the s-bend, so widening the pitch is not a fallback.
